summary: Silo/Bucket tabs + 14-day auto-archive feature fully verified end-to-end. Backend: 9/9 pytest cases pass covering compute_bucket routing, GET /api/admin/submissions bucket filter (incoming/priced/archived/all), counts always reflecting the full dataset, archive_after_days=14 constant, `bucket` field on every submission, dealer /submissions/my hiding archived items, and dealer direct-GET on archived Hilux (bf712655-d666-431a-bea8-0e77eb5b9e81) returning 404 while admin gets 200 with bucket=='archived'. Frontend mobile (390x844): silo-incoming/silo-priced tabs render with counts INCOMING 2 / PRICED 1, active silo has cyan border rgb(0,229,255) + tint bg rgba(0,229,255,0.07), header shows '3 active · 1 archived', tapping silo-priced filters list to only PRICED (Mercedes-Benz GLE FB-000003), tapping back to silo-incoming restores the 2 PENDING cards (BMW 3 Series FB-000002 + Toyota Fortuner FB-000001). Desktop (1440x900): stat pills confirmed INCOMING amber rgb(245,166,35) / PRICED cyan rgb(0,229,255) / ARCHIVED grey rgb(142,142,147); chip row is 3-way with numeric badges, incoming active by default (cyan bg+border), clicking admin-filter-archived shows only the archived Toyota Hilux FB-000002 (R 285,000), clicking the row opens the detail pane, admin-filter-priced and admin-filter-incoming switch correctly, search 'BMW' within incoming still filters. Regression: refresh at '/' as admin lands directly in cockpit (no blue-spinner). No blocking issues found. Deprecated console warnings noted (expo-notifications on web, shadow* style props) — non-blocking, already known from iteration 6.

react_native_issues.issue: Dev warning on every route: '[expo-notifications] Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web.' Non-blocking, already reported in iteration 6.
React Native Web deprecation: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Non-blocking, already reported in iteration 6.

action_items: No fixes needed for silo/bucket feature — backend and both frontend surfaces (mobile + desktop) all verified.
OPTIONAL cleanup (pre-existing, not caused by this feature): silence/migrate expo-notifications web warning and shadow*→boxShadow style props.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py:56-78 compute_bucket handles missing/malformed priced_at gracefully (falls back to 'priced' rather than crashing). Timezone-naive priced_at values are re-tagged as UTC before comparison — correct.
backend/server.py:379-387 counts are computed on the full dataset BEFORE the bucket filter is applied — matches spec (badges remain stable regardless of active silo).
backend/server.py:346-352 dealer /submissions/my correctly attaches bucket field then filters archived — dealer never sees archived items in mobile list.
backend/server.py:362-364 dealer direct GET on archived returns 404 (not 403) — matches spec and prevents info leak about existence.
frontend index.tsx:187-207 silo tabs only render 2 (incoming/priced) on mobile which matches spec; archived count is only exposed via the header 'X active · Y archived' summary.
WebAdminDashboard defaults to bucket='incoming' and preserves search within the active bucket (verified by BMW search inside incoming).
seed_data_creation: None — used already-seeded FB-000001 Fortuner, FB-000002 BMW 3 Series (incoming), FB-000003 Mercedes-Benz GLE (priced), FB-000002 Toyota Hilux id=bf712655-d666-431a-bea8-0e77eb5b9e81 (archived, priced_at backdated 20 days).
